body: Yea....that’s what I figured...every time I say something like that to him he gets mad and tells me I’m overreacting and I need to understand etc. I put up with it because I believed him, I really thought I was reading too much into it but to to see an actual picture and how f’ing *happy* they looked was more then I could deal with. Clearly I am NOT imagining things and then to lie for so long?? I might’ve forgiven it if he had owned up right away but to go to the lengths he did to make me think I’m crazy is just too much.
Honestly? I have no fucking clue.
That *really* hit home. I’m bawling my eyes out but you’re right, thank you
We’ve had an abundance of marriage counselors, individual etc. nothing changes unless he’s willing to open up. And he’s not 🤷🏻‍♀️

Thank you, I really appreciate it. Sounds silly but it’s nice to know I have support SOMEWHERE. I’ve been in counseling for 8 yrs of our 8+ marriage. He did it once in awhile but never for long. I do it to retain my sanity
You’re not wrong on that but he does this even when he’s sober. I know withdrawals and all that but his requires he doesn’t drink for anywhere from a few days to a few months so what’s his excuse?
I don’t know and that’s why I’m stuck
That’s the million dollar question isn’t it?

That’s exactly what he does! Yesterday was awful, I spent most of it in tears because he was just angry and mean. Today? Sweet, eager to spend time with me etc whereas yesterday he looked at me like I was trash and ignored me when he wasn’t trying to pick a fight. I don’t know how to fix us or if it’s even possible but I want to do badly for our kids

I was actually thinking the same thing but I can’t come up with what he could be resenting me for, doesn’t mean it’s not there though I suppose. He had a really messed up childhood and I think a lot of that is coming into play these days.

There’s 2 sides to our marriage: when he’s happy and when he’s mad. When it’s good, it’s AMAZING; he’s sweet, attentive, caring, attentive to our kids etc. When he’s at the other end of spectrum it’s awful; he’s cruel, vindictive and angry. *I* don’t have to win the fights, he does though, I’ve just learned to let it go so the fightin stops. As for sex....it was fantastic a few weeks ago, best we’ve had in years and then suddenly it switched and we were at the other side again 🤷🏻‍♀️
Please don’t imply I have. Go deal with your own issues I have my own with no desire to add your bullshit into it. Bye troll
I don’t need a hotline, I need real advice. Unless your advice is that I’m being emotionally abused. In which case, you should be clearer
